summary: Season 9 Crown Contest has begun, and OddOne achieved a top 5 ranking with a total of 3.476 billion damage across two teams. His first lineup scored over 2 billion damage using Flora and a high-inspiration Talethia. His second team is a Toxin composition that dealt 1.45 billion damage without relying on high inspiration across all premium units. Full team codes, hero positioning, and detailed setups are covered in a dedicated follow-up video.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.note: Deals insane damage when built with high inspiration, carrying a team past 2 billion damage.

heroes.name: Flora
heroes.note: Paired alongside Talethia in the 2 billion damage Crown Contest composition.

teams.note: Dealt 2,019,465,100 damage leveraging high inspiration on Talethia.
Toxin team that dealt 1,457,321,941 damage without needing high inspiration on all premium heroes.

tips: High inspiration on premium DPS like Talethia enables reaching 2B+ damage thresholds in Season 9 Crown Contest.
A Toxin team can reliably break 1.4B damage in Crown Contest even without high inspiration levels across the board.
